stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acusa CNBB de participar de fake news; bispos dizem que ‘mentira não se combate com mentira’

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro accuses CNBB of participating in fake news; bishops say 'lies are not fought with lies'
en.summary: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro claimed that false reports about Brazil's patron saint were created by the Workers' Party with help from inside the National Conference of Bishops. Church officials rejected the accusation.

stories.title: Lula diz que não sabe se polêmica envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora é notícia falsa

en.title: Lula says he does not know if controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Nossa Senhora is fake news
en.summary: President Lula responded to false reports claiming his main presidential rival would remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patron saint, stating such actions would be unacceptable.

stories.title: Ministro de Lula repudia fala de Flávio sobre CNBB ajudar em fake news sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Lula's minister rejects Flávio's claim that CNBB helped spread fake news about Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: A minister in Lula's government contested Flávio Bolsonaro's accusations that the National Conference of Bishops assisted in creating false reports about the patron saint.

stories.title: Lula tenta explorar notícia falsa sobre ‘Nossa Senhora’ e é contestado: ‘fake news, né, presidente?’

en.title: Lula attempts to exploit false news about 'Nossa Senhora' and is challenged: 'fake news, right, president?'
en.summary: President Lula faced criticism for attempting to leverage misinformation regarding Nossa Senhora Aparecida, with opponents questioning his claims about the false reports.

stories.title: Em Goiânia, Flávio Bolsonaro acusa CNBB de ajudar PT com fake news

en.title: In Goiânia, Flávio Bolsonaro accuses CNBB of helping PT with fake news
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential candidate, accused members of Brazil's National Conference of Bishops of collaborating with the PT party to spread false claims that he intends to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Notícia falsa sobre Nossa Senhora tem alcance menor que Dark Horse

en.title: False news about Nossa Senhora has less reach than Dark Horse
en.summary: A false report claiming senator Flávio Bolsonaro would revoke Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patroness if elected has put his campaign on the defensive during a heated contest against president Lula in the final stretch before the first round of voting.

stories.title: Especialistas apoiam decisão de Dino e alertam sobre intervenção judicial

en.title: Experts support Dino's decision and warn about judicial intervention
en.summary: Electoral law experts are questioning the judiciary's role in preserving freedom of expression and democratic debate as the case involving Flávio Bolsonaro and the false Nossa Senhora story escalates shortly before the election.

stories.title: Em decisão sobre publicação a respeito de Nossa Senhora, Dino age a favor do governo, diz leitor

en.title: In decision about Nossa Senhora publication, Dino acts in favor of government, says reader
en.summary: A reader criticizes Supreme Court justice Dino for overturning an electoral authority decision and authorizing a publication about Nossa Senhora that harmed Flávio Bolsonaro, characterizing the action as pro-government.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘PT conseguiu levantar fake news com ajuda de gente de dentro da CNBB’

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says 'PT managed to raise fake news with help from people inside CNBB'
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed that the PT party generated false information with assistance from individuals within the CNBB, a Brazilian Catholic bishops' organization.

stories.title: Caiado critica ‘enfrentamento religioso’ após notícia falsa citando Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora

en.title: Caiado criticizes 'religious confrontation' after false news mentioning Flávio Bolsonaro and Nossa Senhora
en.summary: A political figure criticized what he described as religious confrontation following misinformation that linked Flávio Bolsonaro to Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça e libera post sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision and allows post about Nossa Senhora
en.summary: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino reversed another judge's decision to remove a social media post about Nossa Senhora Aparecida by a comedian that contained political commentary.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça que removeu posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a ‘tirar padroeira’

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision that removed posts about false support from Flávio to 'remove patron saint'
en.summary: Justice Minister Dino reversed a previous ruling that had removed social media posts regarding a political support matter involving a religious figure.

stories.title: Bill Gates pede ao Congresso dos EUA lei para regular segurança da IA

en.title: Bill Gates asks US Congress for law to regulate AI safety
en.summary: Bill Gates called for US Congress to pass legislation on artificial intelligence safety, stating that AI security requires measures beyond industry self-regulation.

stories.title: Israel revoga status diplomático de representantes holandeses na Cisjordânia

en.title: Israel revokes diplomatic status of Dutch representatives in West Bank
en.summary: Israel withdrew diplomatic status from Dutch officials in the Palestinian Authority in response to Netherlands sanctions against Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.

stories.title: Exportações de petróleo do Oriente Médio sobem a 12,8 mi de barris/dia

en.title: Middle East oil exports rise to 12.8 million barrels/day
en.summary: Middle Eastern crude oil exports reached 12.8 million barrels daily in September, the highest level since fighting began between the US, Israel and Iran in February, driven by increased shipments from Saudi Arabia and UAE.

stories.title: Lucros industriais da China desaceleram para alta de 4,2% em agosto

en.title: China's industrial profits slow to 4.2% growth in August
en.summary: China's industrial profit growth decelerated significantly in August, though the cumulative result for the first eight months of the year remained in double digits.

stories.title: Dino anula decisão de Mendonça no TSE e libera posts sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida nas eleições

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision at TSE and allows posts about Nossa Senhora Aparecida during elections
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino annulled a decision by Justice André Mendonça and permitted social media posts about legislation designating Nossa Senhora Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint during the election period.
